latest.title: Completeness of constructible norms
latest.abstract: In the present work we study for a given Banach space the quotient of the family of equivalent norms modulus the collinearity relationship and prove that under a Banach-Mazur type metric this family is a complete metric space, and we also prove the completeness of the family of constructible norms for the Banach space of bounded Lipschitzian mappings between convex sets of a Banach space.
latest.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
latest.workSummary: 证明等价范数模共线关系的商空间在 Banach–Mazur 型距离下完备，并处理一类可构造范数。
latest.breakthrough: 建立特定范数族的完备性。
latest.limitations: 完备性针对指定度量与商关系，不等于经典有限维 Banach–Mazur 紧性。 当前为摘要级分析，方法及结论须回查原文。
latest.priorityReason: 基础结构整理为主，目前与 Ricci 极限及曲率问题的直接联系较弱。
latest.lowPriorityReason: 基础结构整理为主，目前与 Ricci 极限及曲率问题的直接联系较弱。 此为本组阅读顺序，不是质量结论。
